why: One hand always points up. The other hand turns 90 degrees clockwise each time: right, down, left. Next it points up too, so both hands lie on top of each other (one line with two arrow heads). That is option 4. Option 3 (left and right) has lost the fixed up hand.
trick: Treat the arrows like clock hands: keep the fixed hand and turn the moving one by the same step.
